concept: Forgotten Clearing: Mossprout has just arrived in a sparse, humble corner of the Haven.
floor: Sparse broad masses of muted forest moss and warm bare soil with no granular texture; the front half stays open.
main_structure: No structure; one tiny pale-green sprout near the rear-center is the focal point.
rear_props: two or three large rounded rocks grouped at rear-left
side_props: one simple worn rounded watering can at rear-right
